In April, OpenAI launched an upgraded image generation technology called ChatGPT Images 2. Five months later, the company is now releasing the enhanced version, ChatGPT Images 2.5.

ChatGPT Images 2 was a significant leap forward compared to the company's previous image generation tools.

It introduced 2K resolution output, support for multiple aspect ratios, and the ability to use web searches to retrieve the latest information. Images 2 also strengthened its handling of non-Latin language systems and offered two intelligence levels: Instant and Thinking.

The latest Images 2.5 version focuses on "sharper detail, faster generation speed, more precise editing, and improved tools for creating and sharing."

OpenAI stated: "Images 2.5 delivers more natural lighting, richer textures, better preservation of subjects from your reference images, and more reliably follows editing instructions across multiple rounds of conversation."

"We have also reduced image generation latency by up to 50% compared to Images 2.0, so you can generate images and refine your ideas more quickly."

In addition, the company detailed a brand-new "Sketch" feature, which lets users draw directly within ChatGPT and use those drawings as references for image generation. OpenAI is also rolling out templates for popular image formats, a prompt-sharing feature that lets others try out your image generation ideas, and more.

Furthermore, OpenAI is offering developers two versions of Images 2.5 to help them build features into their applications. GPT-Image-2.5 Flare and GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst will be available through OpenAI's API:

GPT‑Image‑2.5 Flare brings the same improvements in quality, editing, and speed to the API, serving as the default choice for most applications, offering higher image quality than GPT‑Image‑2 with 50% lower latency. It is suited to a wide range of scenarios, from creator and social media content, product experiences, visual search, and rapid image prototyping, to large-batch generation. GPT‑Image‑2.5 Sunburst is designed for advanced visual workflows that require more precise editing control. It fits creative and editing workflows such as producing advertising assets or refined product images.

OpenAI stated: "Images 2.5 will begin rolling out today on desktop, mobile, and web to all tiers of ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex users." You can learn more about the new image generation technology here.

This launch of ChatGPT Images 2.5 comes after the release of GPT-6 Astra last week.
